mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.5%, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals strong labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 4.0%, SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) above 1150 and retail sales (RSAFS) above 470000 indicate robust consumer demand, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns through earnings momentum over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 1150 and RSAFS > 470000, SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods, or interaction term Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 104.0 signals weakening manufacturing momentum, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, INDPRO declines do not produce negative SPX 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or INDPRO Rank IC in late-cycle regimes over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A real GDP level (GDPC1) above 17000 billion dollars indicates sustained economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 > 17000, SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index value (CPIAUCSL) above 245 indicates elevated inflation, signaling aggressive monetary tightening that compresses equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 245, SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A high employment level (PAYEMS) above 145000 thousand persons indicates a tight labor market, supporting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS > 145000, SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 1.0% and CPI index (CPIAUCSL) above 245 signal aggressive monetary tightening in response to high inflation, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 1.0 and CPIAUCSL > 245, SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods, or interaction term Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.
